activation.gate_source: Existing engine GCP collect_snapshot selection map; proposal adds seven exact ID-to-kind mappings and preserves Functions.

integration.runtime_case_source: Real installed dual-detector outputs projected from documented synthetic native API JSON; safe full items and full indexes, no expected-field-only fake detector indicators.
integration.engine_dedup: Existing engine deduplicate_secret_findings already merges by provider and process-HMAC value fingerprint; no merger change proposed.
integration.history_fix: Retain the already-redacted marker through Cloud Build history allowlist.
integration.project_marker: Remains inside existing computeConfig; no project collector identity shim or copied marker needed.

privacy.pre_cache_boundary: Hook after successful native response decoding and prior to Transport sanitize(data)/cache assignment.
privacy.always_scrubbed: Sensitive scripts, args/commands, environment values and substitution values are removed before caching even with scans disabled; names and supported nonsecret operational fields remain.
privacy.compute_compatibility: Current sanitizer security keys retained with valid case/whitespace boolean settings; native metadata fingerprint and source_requests/provenance preserved. Invalid scalar values which might themselves contain credentials cannot be retained as security settings.
privacy.retained_detector_output: Engine/version/completion, declared static source field list, bounded byte/part counts, process-random HMAC leak fingerprint and constant source/line positions only.
privacy.network: No credential verification, update checks, archive fetching, Secret Manager reads, URL dereferences or command execution; only native provider GET responses and local detectors.

bounds.cancellation: Native transport check_cancelled before every resource scan; each detector receives at most half remaining page budget.

verdicts.PASS: Both pinned detectors complete with no supported match across all declared returned literal fields; applies only to this bounded current configuration.
verdicts.FAIL: Complete dual-detector coverage with one or more likely-secret matches; value identity deduplicates across tools and resources, with credential validation not attempted.
verdicts.UNKNOWN: Disabled, not explicitly selected, unreadable, missing required configuration, unsupported/masked/foreign request or source, partial response, ambiguous schema union, exhausted bounds/deadline/cancellation, unavailable detector or malformed detector evidence.
verdicts.external_build_configuration: Trigger filename/gitFileSource/autodetect is not dereferenced and cannot produce a clean inline-build verdict.
verdicts.empty_values: Cloud Run literal EnvVar value omission defaults to empty per provider schema; missing parent templates/containers, missing Compute metadata object and missing Build steps remain UNKNOWN.

excluded_surfaces: Secret Manager values and KMS-decrypted Build secretEnv
GCS startup/shutdown-script URL targets and external configuration files
Older Cloud Run revisions, job executions and runtime process state
Cloud Build remote repositories, filename/autodetect build configs, build logs and execution outputs
Unrequested GCP services and provider APIs outside the enumerated inventory

validation.proof: Actual current Transport class compiled with exact proposed pre-cache hook in memory, then mock GETs through cache hit and serialization; full native GCPCollector pipeline cases for all seven kinds, with the proposed safe Cloud Build history allowlist change in memory.
validation.global_dedup: One synthetic value repeated across seven services and both detectors yields one redacted finding with seven linked check IDs.
validation.compatibility: All three Compute kinds tested against existing sanitizer output for nine valid metadata setting representations and native provenance.

root_integration.coverage: 152 native configuration cases plus shared cross-surface dedup and AWS option compatibility; production hooks used directly, not in-memory patched classes.
